nodes.label: Login Page Hero Image
nodes.description: A dark, atmospheric photograph of a shirtless male athlete performing a battle-rope exercise in a dimly lit boxing gym. The scene features exposed brick walls with warm amber accent lighting, industrial overhead pipes, a boxing ring in the background, a punching bag visible on the right, and rubber/wood flooring. The composition uses a wide-angle perspective with the heavy ropes extending toward the foreground camera. The overall mood is gritty, high-intensity, and aspirational — consistent with a fitness franchise or gym management SaaS brand identity. Intended as a full-bleed hero/background image on the login page to establish brand tone.
nodes.design_intent: Establishes fitness/gym brand identity on the authentication screen; creates emotional contrast with the overlaid login form UI
